findings.desc: quality-cleanup: done-merge-experience-refresh-smoke.ts:174 — non-null assertion cache! is unsound (TypeScript cannot infer process.exit(1) as noreturn, so cache remains FindingSignalsCache|null at this point) and the as-number cast that follows is redundant (typeof cache?.coveredFindingCount === 'number' already narrows it). Fix: pull the null guard into a real branch before this line (e.g. if (!cache) { ... return; }), then drop both the non-null assertion and the cast.
